# MIX_REPORT.md — real-mix battle recording (generated by tools/audio/mix_report.py)

Source: `pwsh tools/audio/run_godot_checks.ps1 -Record` — real headless battle r02 with the project's Audio autoload, 02's `Events.sfx` emitters and a scripted player (sandbox AudioProbe). Engine mix via `AudioEffectRecord` on Master after the AudioEffectHardLimiter (driver: headless Dummy (software mix, real time)). Settings at defaults: music 0.8, sfx 1.0.
Length 53.96 s of audio for 60.01 s wall clock. Cue log aligned to audio by onset matching: 42/111 cues within 40 ms (offset -0.052 s, scale 0.9352).

Files for listening: `previews/listen/battle_mix_60s.wav` (exact engine output, 16-bit 44.1 kHz stereo) and `previews/listen/battle_preview_30s.mp3` (19–49 s, the 30 s with the most distinct cues: 10 kinds, 81 cues; 0.3 s fades, no other processing). Chart: `previews/mix_timeline.png`.

## 5. Limits
- Headless Dummy driver mix: same AudioServer mixing code path as devices, but no device output stage, OS mixer, speaker EQ or latency.
- One scripted battle (one round, one seed policy); busier late rounds may differ.
- Masking is a loudness proxy (no psychoacoustic model). Nobody has listened yet; the preview file exists for that.
